blocks.text: The failure of either party to enforce and remedy any noncompliance of the terms and conditions of this Contract Franchise Ordinance shall not constitute a waiver of rights nor a waiver of the other party’s obligations as provided herein. (Ord. 18893 § 12, 6-12-07.)
